Exactly subtract zero, isolated positive loops, balanced disconnected 2+1 components and unbalanced disconnected endpoint+loop components. This yields the stated rational function with (1-z)^7(1+z)^2(1+z+z^2) denominator, first coefficients 9,24,65,156,342,683,1272,2226, and leading 7m^6/8640. Nonzero numerator at primitive 2 and 3 roots establishes *least* quasipolynomial period six. Fresh direct enumeration of every ternary word for 1<=m<=8 matched the first eight counts; this is a finite check, not the all-length proof.
